title: The New Head Chef and the Draft Board

scenes.title: Six Months in the Kitchen and Staff Turnover
scenes.summary: Max reflects on the many cooks who have come and gone during his six months at Claude Monet as Lyova struggles to run the kitchen alone.

scenes.title: Memories of a Rookie and the Doctor's Verdict
scenes.summary: Max remembers his own first day in the kitchen, while at the hospital the doctor tells Chef Barinov that despite good MRI results he cannot return to work for two months.

scenes.title: Elena's Visit and Introducing the New Chef
scenes.summary: Embarrassed to be seen in a hospital bed, Chef Barinov begs the orderly to tell Elena Pavlovna he is not there, while Nagiyev introduces a new head chef at Claude Monet.

scenes.title: The Young Genius Aleksandr
scenes.summary: Nagiyev introduces young culinary star Aleksandr Sergeyevich to the skeptical kitchen crew, while Elena Pavlovna brings flowers to a flustered Viktor Petrovich in the hospital.

scenes.title: A Confession in the Ward and a Favor from the Orderly
scenes.summary: Elena urges Viktor Petrovich to fight for his health for the sake of his daughter and her, and after she leaves, Barinov asks the orderly for a special favor.

scenes.title: Rustic Tuna Salad
scenes.summary: New chef Aleksandr charms the kitchen staff by spinning a dramatic story about inventing a rustic tuna and quail egg salad in a remote village.

scenes.title: The Cooks' Envy and a Tip for Max
scenes.summary: While Senya, Fedya, and Lyova grumble that Aleksandr only got ahead through connections, the new chef wins Max over with a helpful cooking tip.

scenes.title: A Heart-to-Heart in the Office
scenes.summary: Aleksandr invites Max into the chef's office for a drink during work hours, asks about his army service, and quizzes him about which women in the restaurant are single.

scenes.title: Pursuing Vika and Sasha's Bracelet
scenes.summary: Aleksandr sets his sights on art director Vika after learning she is single, while Sasha shows off a new bracelet at the bar.

scenes.title: The Orderly's Trick
scenes.summary: When Elena checks on Viktor Petrovich at the hospital, the orderly follows Barinov's instructions and pretends the Chef was muttering in his sleep about Elena having a family.

scenes.title: Elena's Revelation and Hitting on Vika
scenes.summary: Elena tells Viktor Petrovich that she is divorced and no longer lives with her husband, while at Claude Monet Aleksandr uses a new dish as an excuse to flirt with Vika.

scenes.title: The Kitchen Sabotage Plan
scenes.summary: Fed up with Aleksandr showing off by spending two hours on a single dish for Vika, Lyova, Senya, and Fedya plot to abandon him during the evening rush.

scenes.title: The Manufactured Kitchen Rush
scenes.summary: As dinner service begins, Senya, Fedya, Lyova, and Louis all invent excuses to leave the kitchen at once, leaving Aleksandr completely alone with a flood of orders.

scenes.title: A Warning for Vika
scenes.summary: Having realized that Aleksandr steals stories and lies to impress women, Max tries to warn Vika in the dining room, but she brushes him off as jealous.

scenes.title: Max Saves the Dinner Service
scenes.summary: Returning to the deserted kitchen as Nagiyev demands his steak tartare, Max steps in to help Aleksandr power through the mountain of dinner orders.

scenes.title: Max Becomes Sous-Chef
scenes.summary: When Lyova, Senya, and Fedya stroll back into the kitchen after the rush, Aleksandr punishes Lyova by demoting him and naming Max the new sous-chef.

scenes.title: A Party for One Star
scenes.summary: When all the cooks skip the party and Vika tries to leave too, Aleksandr admits he arranged the entire evening just to be alone with her, prompting Max to confront him.

scenes.title: Fighting Over Vika and Firing Max
scenes.summary: Aleksandr punches Max during their confrontation behind the scenes, lies to Vika about what happened, and tells Max the next morning that he is fired.

scenes.title: Exposing the Faker in the Ward
scenes.summary: When Elena visits the hospital while Chef Barinov is pretending to be unconscious, his ward neighbor tricks Barinov into sitting bolt upright by mentioning Spartak's football match.

scenes.title: An Autograph for the Draft Board
scenes.summary: Remembering that Aleksandr dodged the military draft, Max sends a uniformed officer into the dining room to ask the vain chef for an autograph on a draft summons.

scenes.title: Restoring the Status Quo
scenes.summary: With Aleksandr hauled off to the army, Lyova reinstates Max as a regular cook while Timur bursts into the hospital ward and ruins Barinov's second attempt at playing unconscious.
